content.text: Finding submitted: Section 7(a)–(b) is mutual but fails the fallback because the cap has no 12-month fee basis and carries no carve-outs (its sole exception points to "Paragraph 9", which is the Independent Contractor clause). The redline sets both caps at fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim and adds one mutual carve-out sentence for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
